about_the_game:
::::::::::::::::::::|  GOAL OF THE GAME |::::::::::::::::::::

Create a Build around a strategy that works for you!

Summon your Monsters and Roll to grow your assault!

Play strategically to finally Destroy your Rival's Gem Master!

::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::|  Builds  |::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

Create your Build to use against your Rival!

  • Builds are a mix of Monsters and Dice!

  • With over +1000 combinations, there's no telling what kind strategy you could make!

  • Save Builds to use at any time!

  • Share Builds with other Players!

  • Use the same Build for both Players for a mirror-match!

:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::|  Dice Rolls!  |:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

Roll your Dice to collect GRIT!

  • Pick your Dice to Roll for a chance to get what you need!

  • ATTACK GRIT for Combat!

  • MOVE GRIT for moving Monsters!

  • FOCUS GRIT to use Monster Abilities!

  • GEM GRIT to Summon Monsters!

  • TILE GRIT to grow your Path!

:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::|  Tile Paths  |::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

Build a Path to move your Monsters!

  • The further your Path, the closer you can Summon Monsters!

  • Place Tiles strategically to block your Rival!

  • Use Monster Abilities to punish your Rival's Tile Placement !

::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::|  Abilities  |::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

Every Monster has an Ability, so why not use it?!

  • Buff your own Monsters with Abilities!

  • Use Ailments to debuff your Rival's Monsters!

  • If you're in a pinch, Abilities can completely turn the game around!

:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::|  Attack and Destroy  |:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

Move your Monsters to Attack and Defeat your Rival!

  • The Unique Combat allows both the Attacker and Defender to deal Damage!

  • If you don't build to Defend or Attack, then you may succumb to Combat!

  • There is no limit to your total Summons, so you are able to keep sending out fodder!

  • If you defeat your Rival's Gem Master, then you Win!

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel 4th Gen Dual Core 2.0Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvida GTX Series 8
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Does your sound work? If so, you're good! :D
  • Additional Notes: A very lightweight game. Potatoes could run it.

short_description: Prepare to challenge your friends in this mix of Dice, Monsters, and Strategy! Best your opponent by building your own mix of Monsters and Dice. Then, expand your path to fight your Rival's monsters using abilities to boost your own Monsters! The first to knock out their opponent's Gem Master wins!
